notes: Corrected under rule 29. The ASV writes one *The* for *The men of Ramah and Geba*, and the chain's first nomen rectum הָרָמָה carries an article morpheme, so that morpheme takes the fronted *The* and אַנְשֵׁי takes only *men*. This is the same treatment the chapter gives הַגּוֹלָה in v.6, הַקֳּדָשִׁים in v.65, הַקָּהָל in v.66 and הָאָבוֹת in vv.70–71.

The accepted alignment supplied the *The* on the construct and marked the article `unrepresented`, reading rule 29's final clause as though it turned on the ASV writing no *the* for the place name; the clause turns on no *the* for the phrase.
